# 08: First real run: index, calibrate, validate

**What to build:** with the real Documents and Test Queries in place, the three Knowledge Bases are indexed, the Similarity Threshold is chosen from a sweep over the calibration split, and the validation split is measured once as a Langfuse Experiment, producing the numbers the notebook and the README will report.

**Blocked by:** 07 (Langfuse Experiment). External dependency: the Documents for the three Areas (LLM-generated at the author's request and reviewed by the author) and the Test Queries file (generated by a different LLM at the author's request from an author-fixed prompt, and validated against the Documents; PRD "Out of Scope").

**Status:** done

Scope (PRD "Knowledge Bases", "Checks and calibration", "Further Notes"; ADR 0001):

- Wire the real system in `multi_agent_system.py`: read `Settings` once with `load_settings()`, build the real chat models, the persisted-Chroma `retrieve` callables and the Langfuse client with `init_langfuse()`, and pass them already built to `build_router`, `build_specialists`, `build_graph` and `build_answer_query` (ADR 0003). No other module reads `Settings`.
- Index the three real Knowledge Bases into the persisted directory with the configured embedding model.
- Run the sweep over the calibration split and save the output file; pick the middle of the good zone and set the Similarity Threshold in the environment template and the Settings default.
- Run the validation Experiment once and record the run link and the resulting routing accuracy, retrieval hit rate and abstention counts per Area.
- Any Frontier Query misrouted is examined against ADR 0001's ownership rule; the remedy order is better Area descriptions, then a stronger Router model, then new few-shot examples never taken from the Test Queries.

- [x] `multi_agent_system.py` is the only module in `src/` that calls `load_settings()`; an integration test answers one Query through the real wired system (skipped without API keys).
- [x] A test asserts each Knowledge Base yields more than 50 Sections from the real Documents.
- [x] The sweep output file exists and lists one point per candidate threshold; the chosen threshold is recorded in the plan and in configuration.
- [x] The validation Experiment ran once; its link and per-Area results are recorded for tickets 09 and 10.
- [x] No Test Query text was added to any prompt.

## Comments

**Wiring (commit 5a8a374):** `build_support_system(data_dir, persist_directory) -> SupportSystem(answer_query, retrieve_by_area, langfuse)` in `multi_agent_system.py` reads `Settings` once, indexes idempotently and wires everything (ADR 0003). It raises `ValueError` when the Langfuse keys are missing. Tests: integration `test_support_system_built_from_the_real_documents_answers_an_hr_query`; unit `test_each_real_knowledge_base_holds_more_than_fifty_sections` (HR 69, tech 76, finance 62 at 800/120 tokens; public interface, in-memory Chroma, fake embeddings), `test_only_the_composition_module_reads_settings`, `test_no_test_query_text_appears_in_the_source`. The run scripts live outside the repo (author's decision); ticket 09's notebook is their permanent home.

**Calibration (author-approved):**

- Sweep over the 29 calibration Test Queries with an Area, 20 thresholds from 0.25 to 0.725. With top-k 3, retrieval hits peak at 23/24 (0.25 to 0.40); hr-03's expected Section ("Conflictos de interés") ranks 4th (0.507 vs 0.516). With top-k 4 they peak at 24/24 over the same range. `outputs/threshold_sweep.json` holds the top-k 4 sweep.
- No good zone exists: no threshold blocks the unanswerable Test Queries without losing answerable ones (lowest expected Section 0.408, hr-05; best unanswerable Section 0.620, hr-13). Correct Abstentions are 0/5 up to 0.475. Recorded in ADR 0004.
- Chosen: Similarity Threshold **0.325** (middle of 0.25 to 0.40) and top-k **4**, in the `Settings` defaults, `PLAN.md` §3.5/§3.6 and the PRD. The author set the same two values in the environment template (`.env.example` is permission-blocked for the agent, so the author edits and commits it).
- Verified read-only: Similarity = 1 − cosine distance (matches a manual cosine within 1.3e-6); the HNSW top 3 equals the exact ranking for all 29 Queries; the sweep uses `>=` like the Specialist; a re-run reproduces the saved file. OpenAI embeddings vary slightly between calls (up to about 2.5e-3 in Similarity), with no ranking change seen.
- Thin margins to watch in validation: finance-09's expected Section is 0.0002 below rank 1; tech-03 and hr-10 rank 3.

**Validation Experiment (ran once, 2026-10-12, threshold 0.325, top-k 4, Router/Specialist gpt-4o-mini, Judge gpt-4.1):**

- Run: `first-real-run - 2026-10-12T00:15:41.402148Z` on Dataset `support-routing-validation` (16 Test Queries): https://us.cloud.langfuse.com/project/cmv48hrxk012mad0iu5ad20ir/datasets/cmv4i3rx1007jad0jplfx4dyb/runs/5f3204c8-6778-44ae-afe2-196774aef162

| Area | Test Queries | Routing correct | Retrieval hits | Abstentions (unanswerable) | Abstentions (answerable) | Judged | Mean quality |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| hr | 5 | 5/5 | 4/4 | 0/1 | 0/4 | 5 | 9.6 |
| tech | 6 | 6/6 | 5/5 | 0/1 | 0/5 | 6 | 9.0 |
| finance | 3 | 2/3 | 2/3 | — | 0/3 | 3 | 10.0 |
| out_of_scope | 2 | 2/2 | — | — | — | — | — |
| **Total** | **16** | **15/16 (93.8%)** | **11/12 (91.7%)** | **0/2** | **0/12** | 14 | 9.4 |

- No Frontier Query was misrouted (4/4 correct), so the ADR 0001 remedy order was not triggered.
- finance-07 (direct) was routed to hr: the Router read "plástico de la empresa" (the company card) as equipment and ignored "Tesorería". The hr Specialist answered about the lost credential, and the Judge rated it 10/10 because the Judge checks the Answer only against the Sections it received, so it cannot see a wrong Route. Not tuned after validation, to keep the validation split clean.
- Both unanswerable Test Queries (hr-15, tech-15) got no Abstention (`check_abstained` false), as ADR 0004 predicts. The Specialist's text still declined correctly ("No se menciona en las secciones..."), and the Judge rated them 9 and 6.
- Findings for tickets 09 and 10: (1) the `abstained` flag undercounts declines, because the Specialist's prompt makes it decline in text; (2) a high Judge rating does not mean the Route was right.

**Approval (2026-10-12):** the author approved ticket 08 and its decisions: run scripts kept outside the repo until ticket 09; Similarity Threshold 0.325 and top-k 4 (ADR 0004); `PLAN.md`, PRD and ADR updates; validation not tuned after its single run; the Section-count test moved to the knowledge base public interface after review; PRD line on Document authorship corrected.
